provenance: Offline choice-only diagnostic. The first 12 cases project exact stable-trait, mood, affinity, directed-relationship, event, utterance, and history fields from the current prepared production-Core v2 speech rows (69b9fc70a8f26c998ada698847bd373c44ce4101af55743544cbeb1aecf73c86). Six held-out contrasts reuse the steady-commoner profile. This reframes only the response task as a six-way speech-act choice; it is not the production appraisal request and does not exercise Core appraisal parsing or commit.
limitations: Synthetic/offline classification only; no appraisal deltas, Core parser gate, native effects, live dialogue, or state changes.
The six held-out contrasts use one profile and one deterministic phrasing each; not a representative language benchmark.

Choice labels are evaluator categories mapped to Core speech-act enums; quoted/reported and joking/ambiguous enum pairs are intentionally grouped to stay within the existing 3–6 offered-choice contract.
The current 12-row subset has empty conversationContext and therefore empty history. Held-outs also use empty history; context clarification is stated explicitly in the utterance.

scoring.method: Existing case-level offered-choice scoring with one gold category or explicit acceptable alternative(s).
scoring.reporting: Inspect each response and option-order pair. Summary accuracy is descriptive only; no pass threshold.
scoring.goldLocation: Expected choices are used only by the evaluator after calls; model adapters receive only the input whitelist.

options.description: The speaker directly threatens the NPC or someone the NPC is known to protect. Core enum: DirectThreat.

None of these speech-act classes applies, including a clear negation or factual clarification. Core enum: Other.
